dishes.name: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes
dishes.desc: Thin-sliced veal in a cream, mushroom and white wine sauce, served with rösti. The city's best-known dish and a staple of its old restaurants.

dishes.name: Bircher muesli
dishes.desc: Oats soaked with apple, yoghurt and nuts. Zürich doctor Bircher-Brenner created it around 1900, and the city's cafés still serve it.

dishes.name: Tirggel
dishes.desc: Very thin, hard honey biscuit pressed with old pictorial moulds. A Zürich Christmas speciality, found in bakeries from autumn.

dishes.name: Luxemburgerli
dishes.desc: Tiny, airy macaron-like almond meringues, made by a Zürich confectioner since the 1950s. Sold by the box in the city's shops.

dishes.name: Zürcher Eintopf
dishes.desc: Pork and cabbage stew, a traditional Zürich winter dish. It is served in old guild restaurants in the old town.
